B. Is this measure already running in Ostrobothnia wellbeing services county (or in the Tyks university hospital area that treats its patients)?
A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure raise the share of lung cancer patients who get curative-intent treatment, and by how much?
Measure: Travel and accommodation support for patients far from the university hospital. Patients who must travel for surgery or weeks of radiotherapy get a booked patient hotel, organised transport and a named contact, so that distance is not the reason to choose a non-curative treatment.
effect_summary_en: A registry study from northern England links the longest travel time to lower odds of lung cancer surgery (OR 0.60, 0.44–0.84). It did not test travel or accommodation support, so it cannot confirm the assumed +1 percentage point.
supported_en: Crawford et al. (British Journal of Cancer, 2009) found that patients in the longest travel-time quartile had odds of surgery 0.60 times those of the nearest.
not_supported_en: No study read measures the effect of travel or accommodation support on the share of patients treated with curative intent.
in_use_summary_en: No public sign was found that Tyks or Ostrobothnia wellbeing services county provides booked accommodation, organised transport and a named contact for patients travelling to Turku. Ostrobothnia wellbeing services county says Vaasa has no hotel accommodation at present, only small-scale cooperation with a few local hotels, and that a patient hotel there could open in 2029–2030.
summary_en: Ostrobothnia wellbeing services county (31.8.2026) says the Vaasa central hospital area has no hotel accommodation at present, only small-scale cooperation with a few local hotels. A privately built patient hotel there could open in 2029–2030. The Tyks lung cancer page and a search for Tyks accommodation showed no patient hotel or travel support. The only effect evidence is an English association study (surgery OR 0.60 for the longest travel time), not a study of support measures.
unanswered_en: Whether Tyks offers a patient hotel or booked accommodation for patients from Ostrobothnia was not found on any official page.
